[P2] Evaluate simpler inheritance policies before adding hidden state

CONTRIBUTING rule 2.5 requires the description to explain which simpler alternatives were considered and why they do not work. Its alternatives discussion covers checkpoint flushing, but not this separate inheritance mechanism. The sentinel and explicitness flag make otherwise equal `StepConfig` objects behave differently, and `dataclasses.replace` changes whether they inherit the execution default. That adds a construction-dependent public behavior without the required design comparison. Please return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and evaluate a simpler policy, such as applying execution defaults only when no step config is supplied, documenting why any additional capability justifies this complexity.
